pre_condition: rel_path is a string representing a file path relative to the project root. submodules is either None or a non-empty list of subdirectory name strings.
post_condition: Returns True when submodules is None; returns True when submodules is a non-empty list and rel_path identifies a file residing within one of the named submodule directories; returns False when submodules is a non-empty list and rel_path does not reside within any named submodule directory.
